notes.zh:
・全面對齊蕉葉堂（shoyodo-archive-desk）高規格典雅和風安裝、更新與解除安裝三大原生精靈架構。
・安裝導引支援線上自我版本檢測、既有安裝偵測（全新/升級/修復模式）、路徑自選、磁碟空間驗證與進度回報。
・更新程式支援版本對照徽章、更新內容捲軸檢視、強制更新警告橫幅與「不再提醒」延後功能。
・解除安裝精靈支援台帳挽留建議、僅清理暫存快取（保留雲端紀錄）、離別問卷調查與獨立自毀腳本。
・修復 wason.dev 網站端 404 網址問題（支援 /lab/debate-prep 與 /debate），新增桌面端案頭授權橫幅一鍵回傳金鑰。
・全面修正 Windows 設定中繼資料與 Shell 廣播更新。
notes.en:
・Fully aligned with shoyodo-archive-desk standard for native Installer, Updater and Uninstaller suites.
・Installer features online self-update check, existing install mode detection (fresh/upgrade/repair), path selection and disk space verification.
・Updater features version contrast badges, scrollable release notes, mandatory update banners and snooze reminders.
・Uninstaller features retention suggestions, cache-only reset, farewell feedback survey and detached self-deletion batch script.
・Fixed wason.dev 404 route (/lab/debate-prep and /debate) and added one-click web-to-desktop auth handoff banner.
・Fully registered Windows Settings metadata and shell association change notifications.
